previous_statement: Dependency correction: neither def-ha-map nor def-hcb-datum, nor any AF-registered definition allowed by the registry shard, identifies the amplified form with the coefficient-one coordinate sum <Y,V>_n=sum_i<Y_i,V_i>. The prior attribution to display 1dQ_ip_ext is therefore withdrawn. That formula can be used only after the shard allowlist and AF workspace are provisioned with an explicit amplified-form definition (or a validated dependency having that contract); until then node 1.3.2.2's final equality is unsupported.
new_statement: Correction after provisioning: the AF-registered definition column-hilbert-inner-product-displays contains the byte-matched extended display 1dQ_ip_ext and fixes, for Y,V in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}, <Y,V>_n=sum_i<[Y]_{i1},[V]_{i1}>. With Y_i=[Y]_{i1} and V_i=[V]_{i1}, this is exactly <Y,V>_n=sum_i<Y_i,V_i> with coefficient one. Hence the former assertion that no registered definition supplies this normalization is withdrawn; replacing the amplified form by twice the coordinate sum violates the registered definition, and no further provisioning is required for node 1.3.2.2's final equality.
